summary: Iteration 12 testing covered (1) owner WhatsApp notifications on order create, (2) admin print-address PDF (font bump), (3) product image upload + public /api/uploads/products/* fetch, (4) storage key auto-remint on bad key, (5) GST 5% + Chennai weight-based shipping regression, and (6) frontend Checkout payment step shows exactly UPI/CARD/NETBANKING and no COD. All 5 backend pytest cases pass and the frontend assertion passes.
critical_code_review_comments: msg91.send_order_notification iterates recipients serially using sync httpx.post inside an async order-create handler path; under load this will block the event loop. Consider asyncio.to_thread or httpx.AsyncClient.

storage.get_object/put_object retry logic is correct for 401/403/5xx but silently swallows transient 429s (treated as success -> raise_for_status). Minor; consider including 429 in the retry predicate.

ownerNotifications is persisted even on failure as a single error entry (len==1), which would break downstream code expecting len==2. Consider always writing 2 entries (one per recipient) even on top-level exception.
